body: YE (Kanye West) opened his Houston concert with a powerful and emotional moment, walking out to “True Love” in what appeared to be a tribute to the late XXXTentacion The song choice carried a deeper meaning, bringing back memories of an artist whose music, influence, and legacy continue to resonate with fans around the world.
